boards.title: Your First Weekend at St. John Fisher University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, on-campus sequence for learning Fisher’s gathering, study, outdoor, and creative spaces during an under-21-safe first weekend.

cards.title: Start at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: First stop: campus gathering hub
cards.notes: Begin by getting oriented in the main student gathering spot; use its seating areas to compare schedules, find campus services, and choose your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A central place to pause, orient yourself, and meet up.
cards.evidence_claim: The University identifies the Donald E. Bain Campus Center as its main gathering spot for students; it is open 24/7 and has evening and weekend supervision.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: The University states the Campus Center is open 24/7; follow posted building and event access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Dennis ’72 and Denise Tepas Commons & Terrace
cards.title: Settle into Tepas Commons
cards.subtitle: Next: indoor lounge and outdoor terrace
cards.notes: Choose a table or booth for a regroup, then step onto the terrace to take in the adjacent Keough Quad before continuing across campus.
cards.short_summary: An indoor-outdoor meeting point with flexible seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Tepas Commons has tables, booths, living-room-style furniture, and television; its terrace leads to Keough Quad and includes Adirondack seating and a fire pit.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Use shared seating considerately and check whether an area is reserved for a University group or event.

cards.title: Take a Quad Walk
cards.subtitle: Then: a short outdoor reset
cards.notes: Walk through Keough Quad from the Tepas terrace, using the open space as a simple way to learn the routes between residential and campus-center areas.
cards.short_summary: A named campus outdoor space for an easy orientation walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Keough Quad among Fisher’s outdoor spaces and identifies the Tepas Commons terrace as leading to Keough Quad.
cards.source_title: Our Campus | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and campus programming can affect access; use established walkways and observe posted notices.

cards.title: Plan a Meal at Ward-Haffey
cards.subtitle: Midday: campus dining stop
cards.notes: Use the dining hall as a practical meal break and a chance to learn where new-student orientation groups have gathered for meals.
cards.short_summary: A named dining hall used in the first-year orientation schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher’s first-year orientation schedule names Ward-Haffey Dining Hall as a location for new-student and orientation-group meals.
cards.source_title: First-Year Student Orientation | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Dining access, menus, and payment requirements vary; confirm current dining details with Fisher Dining Services.

cards.title: Find The Nest
cards.subtitle: Afternoon: student-organization hub
cards.notes: Stop by the first-floor Campus Center hub to spot organization offices and decide which club, commuter, or student-government resources to explore later.
cards.short_summary: A community workspace and home base for several student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nest is the student club and organization hub and commuter lounge, housing several student-group offices and open community workspaces.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: The University says all students may use the workspaces and soft furniture; respect meetings and organization offices.

cards.title: Play a Round at Michaelhouse
cards.subtitle: Later: games and lounge space
cards.notes: Meet classmates in the main area for a relaxed game of ping pong, billiards, or an arcade break, then use the couches to continue the conversation.
cards.short_summary: A casual recreation area with games and seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michaelhouse main area has ping pong, an arcade game, billiards, cable television, and couches; Fisher students may use the associated games during and outside SONO Latin Grill hours.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement Spaces | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: The University says this Michaelhouse area does not require ID-card access; equipment availability may vary.

cards.title: Make Lavery Your Study Anchor
cards.subtitle: Early evening: library lounge and workspaces
cards.notes: Locate the lobby, lounge, and workspaces now so you have a reliable place for a short planning session or a quieter break once classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A library with a public lobby, lounge, and student workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher describes Lavery Library as having a welcoming public lobby and lounge, technology-rich classrooms, and student workspaces.
cards.source_title: Our Campus | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Regular building hours list Saturday access until 10 p.m.; a swipe card is required after 10 p.m., and schedules can change.

cards.entity_name: Hermance Family Chapel of St. Basil the Great
cards.title: Pause at Hermance Family Chapel
cards.subtitle: A quiet campus landmark
cards.notes: Add a calm walk-by or reflective pause at the chapel, a campus landmark connected to Fisher’s founding Basilian Fathers and spiritual life.
cards.short_summary: A named chapel that anchors Fisher’s spiritual-life facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The University says the Hermance Family Chapel provides a center for spiritual life on campus and reflects the founding Basilian Fathers’ early vision for Fisher.
cards.source_title: Our Campus | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Check the Chapel or Campus Ministry schedule for services and any access limitations before entering.

cards.title: Check the Ross Gallery
cards.subtitle: Creative stop: Skalny Welcome Center
cards.notes: Walk through the gallery in the Joseph S. Skalny Welcome Center and look for current visual-arts work; treat it as a brief, low-pressure campus discovery stop.
cards.short_summary: A named visual-arts gallery in the Welcome Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University locates the Patricia O’Keefe Ross Gallery in the Joseph S. Skalny Welcome Center and states that it accommodates all visual arts media.
cards.source_title: Our Campus | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and gallery availability may change; check current University information before planning an interior visit.

cards.entity_name: Ralph C. Wilson, Jr. Athletic Center Fieldhouse
cards.title: End at the Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: Finish: locate a major event venue
cards.notes: Finish by finding the Fieldhouse so its role in large campus gatherings is familiar; save workout or event plans for current facility schedules.
cards.short_summary: A major athletic-center venue used for formal first-year programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher’s first-year orientation schedule lists the Ralph C. Wilson, Jr. Athletic Center Fieldhouse as the site of Orientation Kickoff and the Matriculation Ceremony.
cards.source_title: First-Year Student Orientation | St. John Fisher University
cards.access_notes: Facility access and events are schedule-dependent; consult current University athletics or event information before entering.
